audit.whatIsWrong: FABRICATED ABILITY NAME, seven instances. The content layer credits Olaf's lifesteal to 'Vicious Strikes' in whys[1], whys[3], whys[5], spikes[2].text, early, mid, late and wants.foe[2]. Olaf has no ability called Vicious Strikes. His W is Tough It Out, and it grants Attack Speed and a Shield — no lifesteal at all. The lifesteal comes from his passive, Berserker Rage, and it scales with his MISSING health.
audit.why: champ-data/_kits/olaf.json — P Berserker Rage: 'Olaf gains Attack Speed and Life Steal based on his missing Health.' W Tough It Out, cd 16/15/14/13/12: 'Olaf's Attack Speed is increased and he gains a Shield.' This is not a cosmetic naming slip: the page tells the player to fight a lifesteal ability on a 16s cooldown, when in reality the healing is always on and gets STRONGER the lower he goes — which inverts the advice about grinding him down.
audit.corrected: Every instance rewritten to Berserker Rage, with the missing-health scaling stated where the space allows.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four chart rows contradict the packet levelChart and, in two cases, their own why-text: Level 1 is 'Skill' while whys[0] says he out-trades you outright; Level 3 is Olaf; Levels 4-5 is 'Skill' while whys[3] says 'give ground'; and Level 6 is 'Skill' while whys[4] calls E-W-Q into Cask 'your hardest all-in'. Both layers carry all four.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Olaf / Olaf / Skill / Olaf / Gragas / Olaf / Olaf. Mechanically: Undertow is a flat 9s that refunds on pickup and Reckless Swing is true damage on a 11s rank-1 cooldown, so the first levels are his; level 6 is the one row Gragas takes, because a 100s Explosive Cask plus the Body Slam stun is a kill combo Olaf cannot answer while Ragnarok is down.
audit.corrected: win[0] to Olaf, win[2] to Skill, win[3] to Olaf, win[4] to Gragas; phases[0].side to Olaf, phases[2].side to Skill, phases[3].side to Olaf, phases[4].side to Gragas, with ratings and why-text moved with them.

audit.why: HARD at 8.5/10 against a 48% win rate is right, and the shape is right too: he owns levels 1-3, Gragas gets exactly one window at 6, and Olaf reclaims it from first item onward.

audit.whatIsWrong: The kit file tags Undertow with a 'grounding' flag. Riot's description of Undertow says only that it damages, reduces Armor and reduces Move Speed — there is no dash lockout.
audit.why: Recording so a later pass does not write 'his axe grounds your Body Slam'. Per the standing rule, Riot's description beats a derived flag. Note the page does NOT currently make this claim, which is correct.
audit.corrected: Do not claim Undertow grounds Body Slam. The axe stops you by slowing, not by grounding.

edits.before: Olaf owns the early levels here — his Undertow slow keeps you from dodging and his Reckless Swing true damage out-trades your single ability before Happy Hour sustain is even online. Don't try to fight back levels 1-3; your Body Slam telegraphs hard and his Vicious Strikes lifesteal heals through your Q chip. Last-hit at Q range, accept some poke rather than feeding a kill he can snowball, and avoid letting him pick his axe back up for the cooldown refund by forcing him to walk past it under pressure.
edits.after: Olaf owns the early levels here — his Undertow slow keeps you from dodging and his Reckless Swing true damage out-trades your single ability before Happy Hour sustain is even online. Don't try to fight back levels 1-3; your Body Slam telegraphs hard and his Berserker Rage lifesteal heals harder the lower he drops. Last-hit at Q range, accept some poke rather than feeding a kill he can snowball, and deny the axe pickup that refunds his flat 9s Undertow by standing on it or forcing him past it.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 stay rough — his Undertow spam and Vicious Strikes lifesteal still out-grind your W sustain — but level 6 is your one real window. With E-W-Q plus Explosive Cask you can Body Slam him in, land the empowered W auto, sweetspot the Q detonation, and Cask him into your tower if he lives. The catch: only commit when his Ragnarok is on cooldown. If his R is up, your E stun and Cask knockback do nothing and his Reckless Swing true damage ignores your HP bar, so bait it out first.

edits.before: This is Olaf's game. Once he has Vicious Strikes lifesteal and a tank-shred item, his Ragnarok strips your only crowd control and his Reckless Swing true damage melts the beefy HP pool you rely on — you cannot 1v1 him in the side lane. Lean into your level-6 strength: use Explosive Cask to peel him off your carries and knock him into your team rather than dueling him. Group, play the Cask as a disengage tool, and let your team handle the CC-immune all-in you can't stop alone.

notes: This is the worst error found in the slice so far: 'Vicious Strikes' is not an Olaf ability and never appears in the kit file. It is used seven times across the content layer and, worse, the mechanic attached to it is wrong in a way that changes the advice — the page implies his healing is a cooldown you can play around, when Berserker Rage is a passive that gets stronger as he drops. All seven are corrected above. dosFull[2].t 'Anti-heal his sustain' and report[8]'s Executioner's Calling line are both still correct advice against a passive lifesteal, so they were left alone.
